metadata.article_title: Legal representative cannot by delivery only negotiate instrument indorsed by deceased.

article.title: Legal representative cannot by delivery only negotiate instrument indorsed by deceased.
article.content:
57Legal representative cannot by delivery only negotiate instrument indorsed by deceased.

Section 57  ·  Chapter IV  ·  page 16 of the Act
The legal representative of a deceased person cannot negotiate by delivery only a promissory note, bill of exchange or cheque payable to order and indorsed by the deceased but not delivered.
